title: HOW ANNA'S HUMMINGBIRDS GROW FROM NEST TO PERCH
caption: From first wingbeats in the nest to hovering at flowers: Anna's hummingbirds grow fast. Separate archival birds, not one continuous life story. #AnnasHummingbird #Birds #Wildlife #WildVox

narration_timeline.text: This tiny Anna's hummingbird is beating its wings before it can even leave the nest.
narration_timeline.scene: Real nestling practicing wingbeats in the nest, no invented first flight.

narration_timeline.text: While it is still small, an adult returns to the nest with food as the chick grows stronger.
narration_timeline.scene: Separate fledgling perched and adult feeding a nestling, not one continuous individual.

narration_timeline.text: Adult hummingbirds hover at flowers, while Anna's hummingbirds also pause on branches as they move through their territory.
narration_timeline.scene: First authentic hummingbird hovering at red flowers, then a separate verified Anna's hummingbird moving on a lemon-tree branch; do not claim the generic flower bird is Anna's.

narration_timeline.text: At feeders, rapid wingbeats bring them in, and they may perch to take a drink.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic Anna's hummingbird at feeder, perched to drink; do not claim this shot shows hovering.

narration_timeline.text: Even in wet weather, they may sit and wait between feeding trips.
narration_timeline.scene: Authentic Anna's hummingbird perched during wet weather; no synthetic rain.

narration_timeline.text: From a tiny nestling to a young hummingbird hovering at a flower, wing skills grow fast.
narration_timeline.scene: Independent archival juvenile Anna's hummingbird hovering at red flowers, not the same nestling.
